# googleworkspace_group (Resource)

Manages a Google Workspace group and its aliases via the Admin SDK Directory API.

Group membership is managed separately by `googleworkspace_group_members`, and posting and visibility policy by `googleworkspace_group_settings`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleworkspace_group" "engineering" {
  email       = "engineering@example.com"
  name        = "Engineering"
  description = "Everyone in the engineering organization"
  aliases     = ["eng@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String)

### Optional

- `aliases` (List of String)
- `description` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the group's email address or immutable group ID.
terraform import googleworkspace_group.engineering engineering@example.com
```
